text:
Priya (Finance): Heads up — corporate card chargeback posted on account `redwood-enterprise-42` for $12,400. Dispute reason: "Duplicate/Already Paid" from the issuer. Can we gather evidence and decide on provisional credit?
Ethan (Billing): Invoice ID? card last4? processor dispute id?
Priya (Finance): Invoice INV-2026-03-15-324, card **** 8452, processor dispute ID: CHG-98765. Link to invoice PDF: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-03-15-324.pdf
PaymentsBot: Automatic update — chargeback received (CHG-98765). Status: "Under Review". Assigned queue: finance_disputes. ETA for initial response window: 7 days.
Marta (Risk): @Priya can you confirm whether we ever issued a credit or refund for that invoice? Also need subscription snapshot (plan, start/end) and webhook delivery logs for 15–16 Mar.
Priya (Finance): Checked internal notes — no credit issued. Attaching snapshot link and webhook export: gs://redwood-billing/exports/subsnap-INV-324-20260315.csv (uploaded).
Sam (Account Manager): Customer claims they paid via AP wire 2026-03-16 — I have an email thread with treasury. I'll upload receipt.
Ethan (Billing): Running a quick query on ledger to pull all settlement events. SQL: ```SELECT * FROM payments WHERE invoice_id='INV-2026-03-15-324' ORDER BY created_at;``` Will paste results in a minute.
Priya (Finance): If the wire receipt matches our remittance reference, we can submit to issuer as evidence. If not, we may need to escalate to processor for representment.
Marta (Risk): Also need merchant descriptor and billing descriptor screenshot — issuers often flag ambiguous descriptors as duplicate charges. @Ethan can you pull the PSP (payment service provider) settlement feed?
Ethan (Billing): PSP settlement: settlement_id S-20260317-442, descriptor "Redwood Inference Inc." matching invoice. No duplicate settlement found. Pasting txn IDs: pmt_78a9, pmt_78a9-ret — looks like a reversal attempt from the cardholder on 3/18.
Priya (Finance): Uploading customer-provided wire receipt now. Filename: treas-wireremittance-20260316.pdf.
PaymentsBot: Evidence upload detected: treas-wireremittance-20260316.pdf (size 238KB).
Sam (Account Manager): Customer says AP included invoice number but used an internal PO instead of our remittance code — possible mismatch. I've asked them to confirm their bank reference.
Marta (Risk): If remittance doesn't match, we should prepare a partial provisional credit to keep customer live (per chargeback_playbook v2) while we dispute. Approve provisional credit?
Ethan (Billing): What's the provisional amount recommendation? Full invoice or partial? We usually do up to 50% for high-value uncertain disputes.
Priya (Finance): Recommend provisional credit of $6,200 (50%) pending evidence. This keeps account operational and limits exposure. 
Sam (Account Manager): Customer is receptive to partial credit while they hunt the wire. :thumbsup:
Marta (Risk): I'm OK with 50% provisional, contingent on logging decision and creating a case in case-management. I'll assign it to risk_case_1142.
Ethan (Billing): I'll draft the internal credit memo and create a refund transaction placeholder (type: provisional_credit, ref: PC-1142).
Priya (Finance): Action items: 1) Ethan create provisional credit + memo 2) Sam get AP receipt + bank reference 3) Marta start dispute packet for representment if wire not found 4) Priya notify customer and apply credit.
Sam (Account Manager): I'll message the customer and cc finance.
Ethan (Billing): Done — provisional credit created: PC-1142 for $6,200. Memo: "Provisional credit pending wire confirmation for INV-2026-03-15-324 (CHG-98765)"
PaymentsBot: Admin note — provisional credit applied to account redwood-enterprise-42. New outstanding balance updated. Case created: risk_case_1142.
Priya (Finance): Thanks all. If the customer confirms wire with matching remittance, we reverse the provisional credit and close the dispute. If not, Marta please proceed with representment.
Marta (Risk): Will do. Also flagging this for a small process follow-up: update invoice PDF to include clearer remittance code to reduce PO mismatch. Filing a task in billing backlog.
Priya (Finance): Good catch. I'll add to billing docs PR. End of thread.
